name: GetKpiByProduct
description: Get KPI metrics per product/material from SAP: quantity sold, revenue, delivery fulfillment rate. Trigger when user asks about product performance, best-selling items, top products, or per-SKU revenue analysis. All params optional — call immediately on intent match.

materialIdOrName.description: Material ID or partial product name to filter to a specific product (e.g. 'TG11', 'Mountain Bike'). Null to return all products.

fromDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not specified.

toDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not specified.

salesOrg.description: Sales organization code filter. Null if not specified by the user.

top.description: Return top N products by revenue (1–50). Null if not specified.
